## Highlights

Zova 1.0.0-rc.1 is the first candidate for the stable 1.x API, ABI, and storage
compatibility contract. It combines the new in-memory and transactional state
surfaces with explicit, source-preserving migration of released 0.26.1 data.

This is a prerelease. Use it to validate real applications and migrations before
Zova 1.0.0. Compatibility or correctness fixes may require a later release
candidate.

## What's changed

- Added first-class in-memory databases with SQL, KV, object, vector, graph,
  backup, restore, and notification behavior aligned with file-backed databases.
- Added transactional byte-key/byte-value storage, atomic batches, expiry,
  namespace operations, and complete high-level binding coverage.
- Added explicit same-process application notifications with commit delivery,
  rollback/savepoint semantics, bounded queues, overflow reporting, and Rust,
  Python, Go, and JavaScript APIs.
- Added non-mutating storage-format probing and explicit copy-forward migration
  through the CLI, C ABI, Rust, Python, Go, and JavaScript.
- Added immutable released-format fixtures, logical-parity verification,
  source-hash checks, bound-store migration, staged publication, and migration
  fault injection.
- Reduced object-ingestion work by reusing FastCDC chunk hashes across chunk and
  manifest insertion.
- Added the opt-in fixed 1 MiB object profile, streaming object writers and
  readers, range-read hardening, format-11 object schemas, diagnostics, and
  cross-binding support.
- Upgraded the bundled SQLite amalgamation from 3.53.2 to 3.53.4 with official
  source hashes and linked-version enforcement.
- Modularized Zig tests while preserving `zig build test` as the complete gate.

## Candidate 1.x contract

- The candidate public API boundary, binding differences, ownership, errors,
  transactions, notifications, and thread-safety rules are documented in
  `API_STABILITY.md`.
- C ABI numeric components are `1.0.0`; the complete package and ABI release
  identity is `1.0.0-rc.1`.
- Advanced opaque-key graph, edge-payload, topology-scan, and fresh-build APIs
  remain supported low-level C ABI/raw `zova-sys` surfaces. Their omission from
  high-level bindings is deliberate.
- Experimental extension bundle production and application-authored callback
  surfaces are not part of the stable 1.x authoring contract.

## Storage compatibility

- The current `.zova` storage format is 11.
- Released Zova 0.26.1 format-9 databases migrate explicitly through the
  sequential 9 → 10 → 11 registry.
- Retained format-10 databases migrate through 10 → 11.
- Opening never migrates silently. Migration writes a new destination, leaves
  the source byte-identical, and publishes bound stores before the main file.
- Formats older than 9 remain unsupported legacy; downgrades are unsupported.

## Prerelease installation

- GitHub marks this release as a prerelease.
- npm publishes `zova-js` and native companion packages under the `next`
  dist-tag; stable `latest` is not moved.
- Python normalizes the distribution version to `1.0.0rc1`.
- Cargo and Go use the SemVer prerelease identity `1.0.0-rc.1`.

## Known boundaries

The RC does not claim Electron, Deno, browsers, WASM, musl Linux, Windows arm64,
Swift, ANN vector indexes, graph query languages, remote sync, cross-process or
durable notifications, multiple named bound stores, or high-level wrappers for
the specialized raw topology/fresh-build APIs.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/ata-sesli/zova/compare/v0.26.1...v1.0.0-rc.1
